description: The JupyterHub XSRF shape is the one positive: a Tornado get_argument result is caller-supplied and the opposite property is the server's runtime token. Equality alone is insufficient. Three safe Python constant-time calls, a comparison between two caller fields, and an ordinary caller-versus-configuration comparison are silent.

expected.note: handler.xsrf_token independently classifies the opposite side; the constant-time calls and the two one-sided comparisons below do not satisfy both halves
